rationale: Round 2 largely reasserts round 1 positions: labour insists on zero closures and zero compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors continue to keep those instruments on the table and reject unconditional site guarantees. There is some convergence on the need for negotiated restructuring and quantified alternatives, but the core contested issues remain unresolved and the exchange is now circling around the same incompatible red lines.
